current_meaning: At frozen_at the counts in this file equalled the live derivation from the committed axis arrays (source_commit). CURRENT is withdrawn automatically on /api/state and /api/counters the moment the live arrays change: they compare this file's totals with the live counts on every request and report signed_snapshot_agrees false on any drift. It is not a statement that every sentence inside is true.

custody.where: Cloudflare Pages secret BOARD_SIGN_KEY_PKCS8_B64, project councilof-ai; used only inside POST /api/board-sign
custody.shape: single Ed25519 key — not MPC, not threshold
custody.caller_authentication: bearer pod token (Pages secret BOARD_SIGN_POD_TOKEN; copy at ~/.secrets/board-sign-pod-token on oracle-micro-2 and on the pod), or GitHub OIDC from an allow-listed workflow
custody.what_that_means: Anyone holding the pod token, or able to change the Pages secrets, can obtain a signature from this key. The signature proves the file came through the board signer; it does not prove who asked.
